//: This tracked manifest ships Marguerite's built-in, original BGM catalog: four procedurally-synthesised tracks (see scripts/generate-music.mjs and scripts/GENERATOR.md). They are original works by the Marguerite project, released to the public domain under CC0 1.0 — no copyright exposure, ever.
The app's built-in ambient pad is additionally generated at runtime via the Web Audio API (see src/composables/useAmbientSynth.ts) and needs no license at all.

To add your own tracks, drop audio files here and create playlist.local.json (gitignored). When present, playlist.local.json fully replaces this file. Track src is either a filename relative to this directory or an absolute https:// stream.
See README.md in this directory for the full format.
